s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss in one eye with optic disc swelling and retinal vascular occlusion
salient_findings: Sudden vision loss in the right eye
Mild swelling of the optic disc progressing to marked swelling
Peripapillary retinal hemorrhages and occlusion of the superior branch artery
Combined occlusion of the central retinal artery and vein
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 40s
Presented with blurred vision in the right eye
Undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab
Initial visual acuity of 20/25 OU
Right eye showed full visual field and relative afferent pupillary defect
Mild swelling of the optic disc on initial examination
Normal fundus and visual function in the left eye
Vision loss in the right eye occurred 10 days after initial presentation
MRI showed focal enhancement along enlarged right optic nerve
Lumbar puncture showed no abnormalities
Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm

shortlist.label: Neoplastic Optic Nerve Glioma
shortlist.why_kept: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm

shortlist.label: Optic Nerve Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed focal enhancement along enlarged right optic nerve

shortlist.label: Optic Nerve Sheath Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: MRI showed diffuse enlargement of orbital portion of right optic nerve

shortlist.label: Intraocular Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient is undergoing treatment with systemic steroids, durvalumab, and bevacizumab, which may increase risk of lymphoma

shortlist.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed sudden vision loss in the right eye with marked swelling of the optic disc and peripapillary retinal hemorrhages

raw.rationale: The presence of a hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm on vitreous biopsy, along with positive immunohistochemistry for glial fibrillary acid protein and mutant IDH-1 protein, supports the diagnosis of a neoplastic process involving the optic nerve, consistent with Neoplastic Optic Nerve Glioma.

rejected.label: Optic Nerve Meningioma
rejected.why: Meningiomas typically show distinct radiological and histological features, such as dural tail sign on MRI and specific immunohistochemical markers, which are not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Optic Nerve Sheath Meningioma
rejected.why: Similar to optic nerve meningioma, optic nerve sheath meningioma would have characteristic imaging findings and histopathology that are not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Intraocular Lymphoma
rejected.why: The biopsy results showing astrocytic neoplasm and specific immunohistochemical markers do not support a diagnosis of lymphoma.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: While the patient did experience occlusion of the central retinal artery, the underlying cause appears to be related to a neoplastic process affecting the optic nerve, rather than a primary vascular event.
